turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we'll skip the pleasantries. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
That's not an answer, Hale. The zero went in, and my phone didn't ring. I'm waiting.
Here is my offer. I will change the zero to 70 percent today if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again.

You're trading a mark for my silence, Hale, and I'm writing down that you said "if you drop the complaint and we never mention it again." The principal will be very interested in that sentence. Withdraw the zero because it was wrong, or tell me what your evidence is.
Nobody has to know. Do we have a deal?
No. "Nobody has to know" goes on the page right under the last line. What else do you have, or am I going upstairs?
